images.caption: Figure 2:Mistake predictions on two test videos. Our approaches assign a class to each segment; AEM and ESTANet give a binary error decision (pink). The number in each row is the binary F1@0.5 on that video. grey marks that no action is detected.

Figure 3:Examples of detected mistakes. (a) The joint approach flags a slip: the tortilla is dropped on the floor instead of being placed on the cutting board. (b) The modular approach flags a modification: the oats are poured directly from the container instead of being measured with a tablespoon. Span: predicted start and end of the action; decided at: the video time at which the decision was made.
Figure 4:Step segmentation on two test videos. Each color is one step of the recipe; grey is background and black an off-script step. The number in each row is the segmental F1@0.5 on that video.
